# os commands

Every `os` command, with the arguments and options the console actually defines.

## `os:design-skin`

Reskin the OS interface to match a described mood/style (LLM) or a seed hex.

```bash
bin/semitexa os:design-skin
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--prompt` | yes |
| `--hex` | yes |
| `--fast` | no |

## `os:reset-skin`

Revert the OS interface to its default look (clear the active skin).

```bash
bin/semitexa os:reset-skin
```

## `os:weave`

Weave unprocessed conversation turns into the knowledge graph (one LLM extraction pass).

```bash
bin/semitexa os:weave
```

| option | takes a value |
|---|---|
| `--reset-cursor` | no |
| `--all` | no |
